C1079.title: Camera Peeping Black Market Exploits Weak Password Vulnerabilities
C1079.summary: Since May 2021, the Cyberspace Administration of China, MIIT, the Ministry of Public Security, and the State Administration for Market Regulation carried out a concentrated campaign against camera voyeurism and related underground markets, targeting illegal viewing of private camera feeds, trading of private videos, and dissemination of voyeurism techniques. MIIT found more than 40,000 camera vulnerabilities including weak passwords, unauthorized access, and remote command execution, while public security authorities arrested 59 suspects and seized access rights to more than 25,000 illegally controlled network cameras.
